text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Le 24 Septam, 1759, Arthur Guinness finn sign enn bail de 9,000 an pou St James' Gate Brewery dan Dublin, Irland.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, ko-pilot lekip A1GP New Zealand, finn fer listwar zordi kan lin kondir pli vit possib lor 48-an Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legalman.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Mr Reid finn konn kondir A1GP New Zealand so nouvo loto, Black Beauty la, lao 160km/h, set fwa lor pon-la.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: La polis New Zealand finn gagn difikilte servi zot radar vites pou kone ki vites Mr Reid ti pe kondir parski Black Beauty la ti tro ba, e zot finn reysi konn vites Mr Reid zis kan li finn ralanti a 160km/h.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Dan 3 dernie mwa, plis ki 80 dimoun arete fin libere depi fasilite Central Booking san ki zot ti sarze ofisyelman.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: An avril sa lane la, Ziz P Glynn finn tir enn lordonans restriksyon temporaire kont fasilite Central Booking pou fors zot liber bann ki finn tini plis ki 24 er depi zot admisyon san ki zot finn gagn enn akizisyon par enn komiser lakur.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Komiser la fixe bann kosyon, si zot finn akorde, ek formiliz bann sarz ki finn deklare par ofisye kin fer arestasyon la. Bann akizasyon la apre rant dan sistem informatik leta kot pe swiv ka la.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Odisyon la osi mark dat kot sispekt la kav exers so drwa pou ene prose rapid.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, trezorye Ostralyen ek zom ki pli probab pou arive apre Premye Minis John Howard kouma lider parti Liberal finn donn so sipor pou enn lindistri lenerzi nikleyer dan Ostrali.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Mr Costello finn dir ki kan lenerzi nikleyer vinn ekonomicman pratik, Ostrali bizin swiv so lizaz.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Si li vinn komersyal, nou bizin ena li. Se sa, pena okenn obzeksion an prinsip kont lenerzi nikleyer" Mr Costello finn dir.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Pendan trwa dernie deseni, mem si lin ofisyelman rest ene leta komunist, Lasin fin develop ene lekonomi marse.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Bann premie reform ekonomik finn fer anba direksion Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Depi sa, dimensyon ekonomik Lasinn finn miltiplie par 90 fwa.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Pu premye fwa, lane dernyer, Lasinn finn export plis loto ki Lalmayn e finn depas Lamerik kouma pli gran marse pu sa lindistri la.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: GDP Lasin ti kapav vin pli gran ki Lamerik dan lespas de deseni.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Tanpet tropikal Danielle, katriem siklon ki finn nome pendan sezon siklon Atlantik 2010, ti forme dan Losean Atlantik les.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Tanpet la, ki ti trouv a anviron 3000 mil depi Miami, Florida, ena divan regilie ki maximum 40 mph (64 kph).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Ban siantis National Hurricane Center predir ki Danielle pou vin pli for ek vin ene ouragan ziska mercredi.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Vu ki tanpet la lwin ar later, li ankor difisil pou evalye so limpakt potensyel lor U.S ou ban Karaib.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Ne dan kapital Kroat, Zagreb, Bobek finn vin popiler kan lin zwe pou Partizan Belgrade.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Linn zwenn zot an 1945 ek inn rest laba ziska 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Pandan so letan avek lekip la, li ti met 403 but dan 468 laparision.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Person dot finn deza zwe autan ou mark plis but pou klub la ki Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: An 1995, li ti eli couma meyer zwer dan listwar Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Bann selebrasion ti koumanse ar enn spektak spesial par group Cirque du Soleil ki byen renome dan lemond.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Liti suivi par Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, ene band janisser ek ban santer Fatih Erkoç etMüslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Apre Whirling Dervishes finn pran la sen.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Diva turk Sezen Aksu finn zwe avek tenor italien Alessandro Safina ek santer grek Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Pou termine, group dans turk Fire of Anatolia finn presant spektak ''Troy''.
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, ene zenes 13 an ki ti contan fer rali motosiklet, finn desede kan lin fer ene aksidan lor l'Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Kan li ti p fer ene tour pou sofe, Lenz finn tombe depi so moto e fin perkite par ene lot sofer, Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Deswit lin gagn swin depi ban personel medikal lor la pist e finn transporte a ene lopital lokal kot li finn desede apre.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat pa finn blese dan aksidan la.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Konsernan sityasyon finansye mondial, M. Zapatero finn deklare "sistem finansye ene parti lekonomi, ene parti importan.''
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Nou ena ene kriz finansye depi ene an, ki finn ena so moman pli sever dan de mwa dernie, ek mo panse asterla bann marse finansye la pe koumans retourne.
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Semen dernye, Naked News finn anonse ki li pu dramatikman ogmant so manda langaz internasyonal pou informasyon, avek trwa nuvo difizion.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Deza p raporte an Angle ek Zapone, lorganizasyon global pe lans bann program an langaz Espanyol, Italyin, ek Koreen, pu televizyon, lor web, ek lor bann laparey mobil.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: "Erezman nanye pa finn ariv mwa, me mo finn trouv enn senn makab, kot ban dimounn ti pe rod kas la fenet pou kapav sorti deor''.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Bann dimoun ti pe tap bann vit la fenet la avek bann sez, me bann la fenet la pa ti p krase.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: 'Ene ban vit la finn finalman kase, ek zot finn koumans sorti par la fenet," Franciszek Kowal, ene survivan finn dir.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Bann zetwal emet la limier ek saler akoz lenerzi ki prodwir kan bann atom idrozin melanz (ou fusione) ansam pou form bann eleman pli lour.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Bann siantis pe travay pou kree enn reakter ki kapav prodwir lenerzi dan mem fason.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Sa, par kont, enn problem bien difisil pou rezoud, e li pou pran boukou lane avan nou kapav trouv bann reakter fusion ki vremem itil.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Zegwi an asie la flot lor sirfas delo akoz tansion siperfisyel.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Tansion siperfisyel la forme akoz ban molekil delo lor sirfas delo la pli atire ar bann lezot molekil delo ki a kote zot ki bann molekil lair lao zot.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Bann molekil delo form ene la po invisib lor sirfas delo ki permet ban lezot obze couma zegwi flot lor sirfas delo.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Lam ene patin a glas modern ena de bor avek ene trou o milie. De bor la permet ene meyer priz lor la glas, mem si patin la incline.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Akoz anba lam la ena ene tigit kourbe, kan lam la inkline lor ene kote, bor ki pe tous laglas la vinn kourbe li osi.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Sa fer patineur la tourne. Si patin panche a drwat, patiner la vire a drwat; si patin panche a gos, patiner la vir a gos.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Pou retourn zot nivo lenerzi normal, zot bizin zis elimin lenerzi an ekse ki zot ti gagne depi lalimyer la.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Zot fer sa kan zot emet enn tipti partikil lalimyer ki apel enn “foton”.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Bann sientifik apel sa prose la "emision stimile radiasion" parski bann atom stimile par limier briyan, sa ki koz emision enn foton, ek limier se enn kalite radiasion.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Prosin zimaz la montre bann atom ki pe emet bann foton. Bien sir, an realite, ban foton byen pli tipti ki dan sa foto la.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Bann foton mem pli tipti ki bann zafer ki fer bann atom la!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Apre plizir santenn lertan loperasion, filaman dan glob la evantyelman brile ek lanpoul la nepli marse.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Apre sa, bizin ranplas lanpoul la. Li importan ki pran precosyon kan p ranplas glob la.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Premierman, bizin teign switch pou lalimier la ouswa dekonekte kab la.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Se akoz kouran ki pass dan soket la kot parti metalik la ete kapav donn toi enn sok elektrik bien grav si to tous andan soket la ou baz metalik glob la alor ki li ankor an parti dan priz la.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Organn mazer sistem sirkilatwar se leker, ki pomp disan.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Disan sorti depi leker dan bann tib ki apel larter e revinn dan leker dan bann tib ki apel lavenn. Bann pli tipti tib la apel capiler.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Ledan enn triseratop ti p kapav kraz pa zis bann fey me mem bann brans ek rasinn bien dir.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Ena bann siantis ki panse ki ban triseratop ti p manz bann sikad, ki enn kalite plant ki ti komen pendan Kretase.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Sa bann plant la parey kouma ene ti palmie avek enn kouronn fey ki fite ek ki ena bann pik.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Ene triseratop ti p kapav servi so labek for pou rass bann fey avan li manz tron la.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Lezot siantis debat ki sa bann plant la ti byen toxik alor li pa probab ki kit dinozor ti p manz zot, mem si zordi ban pareseu ek bann lezot zanimo kouma peroke (enn desandan bann dinozor) kapav manz bann fey ki toxik ouswa bann frwi.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Kouma gravite Io ti pou ete lor mwa? Si to debout lor sirfas lo, to pwa ti pou mwins ki li ete lor Later.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Ene dimoun ki pez 90 kg lor Later ti pou pez anviron 16kg lor lo.  Alor gravite, evidaman tir mwin presyon lor twa.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Soley pena ene krout couma Later lor ki to kapav debout. Soley forme entye par ban gaz, dife, ek plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Gaz la vinn pli mince plis to ale lwin depi sant Soley.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Parti extern nou trouve kan nou get soley apel photospher, ki ve dir ''boul la limier.''
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Apepre trwa mil an plitar, an 1610, Galilei, enn astronom Italien, ti servi ene teleskop pou observe ki Venus ena bann faz, parey kouma lalinn.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Bann faz la forme parski sel kote Venus (ou Lalinn) ki fer fas Soley ki eklere. Sa ban faz Venus la konfirm teori Copernicus ki ban planet tourn otour Soley.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Lerla, plizir lane pli tar an 1639, enn astronom angle ki apel Jeremiah Horrocks ti observ ene transit Venus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Langleter finn konn ene long peryod lape apre rekonket Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Me an 991, Ethelred ti konfronte ar ene flot Viking pli gran ki ninport ki lezot flot depi pou Guthrum enn siek avan.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Sa flot ti dirize par Olaf Trygvasson, ene Norvezien ki ti ena ban ambisyon reklam so pei depi dominasion Danwa.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Apre bann premye defet militer, Ethelred ti resi vin an akor avek Olaf, ki ti retourn Norvez pou sey gagn so royom avek sikse varyab.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul se sel alfabet ki popiler e servi dan kotidien ki finn invente par expre. Alfabet la finn invente an 1444 pandan regn King Sejong (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Lerwa Sejong ti katriem lerwa Joseon Dynasty e li enn parmi bann ki pli byen respekte.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Li ti orizinalman nom Hangeul alfabet la Hunmin Jeongneum, ki vedir "bann son korek pu lord lepep".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Ena boukou teori lor kouma Sanskrit finn vinn an existans. Ene parmi zot se lor enn migration Aryan depi lwes ver Lend ki finn amenn zot langaz avek zot.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sankrit se ene ansien langaz ek li konparab ar langaz Latin ki ti p koze dan Lerop.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Premye liv koni dan le mond finn ekrir an sanskrit. Apre kompilasyon bann Upanishads, sanskrit finn disparet akoz lyerarsi.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit ene langaz byen komplex ek byen riss, ki sours plisir langaz indien modern, parey couma latin sours ban langaz eropeen couma franse ek espanyol.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Kan batay pou la Frans inn fini, Lalmagn inn prepar li pou envahir Langleter.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Lalmayn finn donn sa atak la ene nom kod "Operasion Sealion". La plipar bann zarm lour ek bann provizion Larme Britanik finn perdi kan li finn evakie depi Dunkirk, alor larme la ti ase feb.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Me marine britanik ti ankor pli pwissan ki marine almand (« Kriegsmarine ») e ti kapav detrwir nimport ki invasion flot ki anvoye a traver la Manche.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Me, byen tigit navir marine britanik ti base pre ar bann la rout invasion ki probab, akoz bann amiral la ti p per ki zot coule par bann attak aeryen ban alman.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Nou koumans par explik ban plan Itali. Itali ti prinsipalman ti frer Lalmagn ek Zapon.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Li ti ena ene larme ek ene marine pli feb, mem si li ti fek constrwir kat nouvo navir avan debu lager.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Ban obzektif principal Itali ti ban pei Africain. Pou pran kontrol sa ban pei la, zot ti pou bizin ene baz pou lans ban troup, pou ki banla kav travers Mediterane ek envahir Lafrik.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Pou sa, zot ti pou bizin debaras zot de ban baz ek navir britanik dan Lezipt. Apart sa ban aksyon la, bann kwirase italien pa sipoze fer nanie dot.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Aster pou Zapon. Zapon ene pei ki ene zil, parey couma Langleter.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Bann soumarin se bann bato ki finn fer pou vwayaze anba dilo, ek res laba pandan enn bon bout letan.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Ti servi bann soumarin dan Premie Lager Mondial ek Deziem Lager Mondial.  A lepok, zot ti bien lant ek zot ti ena enn portee tire bien limite.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Dan koumansman lager zot ti plizoumwin vwayaze lor latet lamer, me kouma radar ti koumans devlope ek vinn pli exakt bann soumarin ti oblize al anba dilo pou evit ki dimoun trouv zot.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Bann sousmarin Alman ti apel U-Boats. Bann Alman ti bien bon dan navige ek oper zot bato anba delo.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Akoz zot sikse avek bann soumarin, apre ki lager bann Alman pa fer konfians pou ena boukou parmi zot.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Wi! Lerwa Tutankhamun, parfwa apel "Rwa Tut" ouswa "Garson Rwa", se enn parmi bann ansien Egiptien pli koni dan lepok modern.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Li ase interessan ki li pa ti konsidere kouma enn figir inportan dan lepok ansien, ek li pa ti ena lor boukou lalis ansien le rwa.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Me dekouvert so tom dan 1922 ti fer li vinn enn selebrite. Boukou tom ansien ti viktim vol, me sa tom la ti preske intak.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Laplipar bann zafer ki finn antere avek Tutankhamun finn bien prezerve, parmi ena plizir milye artefak ki finn fer avek bann metal presie ek bann ros rar.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Invansion bann larou rayon ti fer bann saret Asirien pli leze, pli vit, ek pli bien prepar pou depas bann solda ek lezot kales.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Bann fler depi zot ark mortel kapav penetre larmir bann solda rival. Aproximativman 1000 B.C., bann Assyrien ti introdir premie kavalri.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Kavalri se enn larme ki lager lor seval. La sel pa ti ankor invente, alor kavaleri Assyrien ti lager lor ledo nake zot cheval.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Nou konn boukou politikien, sientifik, ek artist Grek. Kapav dimoun pli koni sa kiltir la se Homer, poet lezander aveg, ki ti kompoz de mazer travo literatir Grek: bann poem Iliad ek Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles ek Aristophanes ankor ekrivain teatrik popiler ek zot bann travo konsidere kouma parmi bann travay pli gran literatir lemond.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Enn lot Grek seleb se enn matematisien Pitagor, ki laplipar koni pou so teorem seleb lor relasion bann triang kote drwat.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Ena bann estimasion varye pou komie dimounn koz Hindi. Li estime ki li ant deziem ek katiem pli komin koze langaz dan lemond.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Kantite dimoun natif ki koz sa li varye dapre si kont bann dialek ki bien pros ouswa non.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Bann estimasion li depi 340 milyon ziska 500 milyon dimounn ki koz sa lang-la, ek otan ki 800 milyon dimounn kapav konpran sa lang-la.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi ek Urdu resanble dan vocabiler me diferan dan skript; dan konversasion toulezour, bann dimoun ki koz sa langaz la kapav konpran enn lot.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Around the 15th syek, nor Estonia ti anba gran linflians kiltirelman depi Germany.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Sertin moine Alman ti anvi fer Bondie vinn pli pre ar bann dimounn natif, alor zot ti invant lang literal Estonien.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Li ti baze lor alfabet Alman ek ti azout enn karakter "Õ/õ".
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Amezir ki letan ti pe pase, boukou mo ki ti prete ar Alman ti pe zwen. Sa ti koumans enn lepok leklere.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Tradisionelman, eritier lor tronn ti al direk dan militer apre fini lekol.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Me, Charles finn al liniversite dan Trinity College, Cambridge kot li finn etidye Antropolozi ek Arkeolozi, ek plitar Listwar, gagn enn 2:2 (enn degre dezyem klas).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles ti premie manb Fami Lerwa Britanik ki finn gagn enn degre.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turki Lerop (lest Thrace ouswa Rumelia dan peninsil Balkan) inklir 3% teritwar pei-la.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Territwar Turki plis ki 1,600 kilomet (1,000 mi) long ek 800 km (500 mi) larz, avek enn form preske kare.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Zirisdiksion Turki, inklir lak, okip 783,562 kilomet kare (300,948 km2) teritwar, parmi ki 755,688 kilomet kare (291,773 km2) dan sid-les Lazi ek 23,764 kilomet kare (9,174 km2) dan Lerop.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Grander Latirki fer li 37em pli gran pei dan lemond, ek li apepre grander Lafrans Metropolitenn ek Rwayom Ini ansam.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkey antoure par bann lamer lor trwa kote: lamer Eze an oksid, lamer Nwar an nord ek lamer Mediterane an sid.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg ena enn long listwar me so lindepandans date depi 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Bann parti prezan Belgium ti parti Luxembourg dan lepase me vinn Belze apre Revolision Belze 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxembourg finn touzour esey reste enn pei net me li ti okipe par Germany dan Dezyem Ger Mondyal ek Premye Ger Mondyal.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: An 1957 Liksborg ti vinn enn manb fondater lorganizasyon ki zordi koni kuma Linyon Eropein.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong se enn fortes ki finn detrui ek enn monasteri Bouddis dan parti sup Paro District (dan Phondey Village).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Ena dir ki an 1649, Namziel Zhabdrung Ngawang ti kree fortres pou komemor so viktwar kont bann lafors Tibet-Mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: An 1951, enn dife ki finn koze pu ki zis sertin relik Druggie Dzong reste, kuma zimaz Zhabdrung Ngawang Namzial.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Apre dife, fortres ti prezerve ek proteze, ti res pou li enn bann latraksion pli sansasionel Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Pandan 18em siek Kanboj ti trouv limem ant de vwazin bien pwisan, Tayland ek Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Bann Tay ti anvayir Kanboj plizir fwa dan 18em siek ek an 1772 zot ti detrir Phen Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Dan bann dernie lane 18em siek bann Vietnamien ti osi anvayir Kanboj.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Dizwit poursan bann Venezuelan pena travay, ek laplipar bann ki travay dan lekonomi informel.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: De tyer Venezuelan ki travay fer sa dan sekter servis, preske enn kar travay dan lindistri ek enn sinkyem travay dan lagrikiltir.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Enn inportan lindistri pou Venezyelien se petrol, kot pei la enn net exportater, mem si zis enn pourcent travay dan lindistri petrol.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Dan koumansman lindepandans, expertiz Zardin Botanik Singapour finn ede pou transform lil-la dan enn Lavil Zardin tropikal.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: An 1981, Vanda Zoakim, enn ibrid orkid, ti swazir kouma fler nasional nasion la.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Sak lane ver Oktob preske 1.5 milyon erbivor vwayaz ver bann laplenn dan lesid, ki travers Larivier Mara, ki sorti dan bann kolinn lenor pou gagne lapli.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: E lerla retourn dan lenor atraver lwes, ankor enn fwa travers larivier Mara, apre lapli ver Avril.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Larezion Serengeti ena Park Nasional Serengeti, Zonn Konservasion Ngoron ek Rezerv Zwe Maswa dan Tanzani ek Rezervasion Nasional Maazai Mazai dan Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Pou aprann kree bann media interaktif, bizin ena bann konpetans konvansionel ek tradisionel, ek osi bann zouti ki metrize dan bann klas interaktif (anbarkasion zistwar, edision odio ek video, rakont zistwar, etc.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Dizayn interaktif exize ki ou re-evalye ou bann asompsyon lor prodiksyon media ek ki ou aprann panse dan enn fason non-lineer.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Dizayn interaktif exize ki bann kompozan enn proze konekte ansam me ki zot osi fer sans kouma enn entite separe.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Dezavantaz bann lenz zoom se ki konpleksite fokal ek kantite eleman lenz ki bizin pou realiz enn seri longer fokal li boukou pli gran ki pou bann lenz prime.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Sa pe vinn mwins enn problem amezir ki bann fabrikan lenz realiz bann standar pli ot dan prodiksion lenz.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Sa finn permet lenz zoom prodir bann foto kalite ki konparab avek sa ki lenz fix fokal kapav fer.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Enn lot dezavantaz bann lenz zoom se ki louvertir maximem (latet) lenz-la normalman pli ba.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Sa fer lenz zoom bon marche difisil pou servi dan kondisyon limier ba san enn flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Enn problem ki pli komen kan ou pe konverti enn film pou format DVD se overscan.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Laplipar televizion fer dan enn fason pou fer plezir piblik an zeneral.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Pou sa rezon-la, tou seki to trouve lor televizion ti ena bann bor koupe, lao, anba ek kote.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Sa fer pou ki zimaz-la kouver lekran-la an-antie. Samem apel overscan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Malerezman, kan ou fer enn DVD, bann bor la osi koupe, ek si video la ena sous tit anba, zot pa pou montre an totalite.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Sato moyen-âge tradisionel finn inspir limazinasion depi lontan, finn konzige bann zimaz bann lager, bann banke ek bann sivalri Arthurien.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Mem debout omilie bann rwinn ki ena mil lane li fasil pou panse bann son ek bann loder bann batay ki finn disparet depi lontan, pou preske tann tapaz sabo lor bann pave ek pou santi laper ki pe monte depi bann trou danze.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Me eski nou limazinasion baze lor realite? Kifer finn konstrir bann sato o-koumansman? Kouma finn konsevwar ek konstrir zot?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Tipik pou sa ler la, kastel Kirby Muxloe plis enn lakaz fortifie ki enn sato.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: So bann gran lafnet glase ek so bann miray mins pa ti pou kapav reziste enn latak determinan pandan lontan.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Dan bann lane 1480, kan so konstriksion ti koumanse par bann  Lord Hastings, pei la ti relativman pasifis e ti bizin zis kont bann ti group maroder ki ti pe fer letour.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Balans puvwar ti enn sistem kot bann nasyon Eropein ti pe rod gard suverennte nasyonal tu bann leta Eropein.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Konsep la ti ki tu nasyon Lerop ti bizin rod anpes enn nasyon vinn pwisan, e donk bann guvernman nasyonal suvan sanz zot lalyans pu ki zot kapav gard lekilib.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Lager Siksesion Espagnol ti mark premie lager ki so kestion santral ti balans pouvwar.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Sa ti mark enn sanzman inportan, parski bann puvwar Eropeen pa ti pou ena pretext vinn bann lager relizye. Donk, Ger Trant-an ti pou dernie lager ki ti etikete kouma enn ger relizye.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Tanp Artemis dan Efesus ti detrir le 21 Zilye 356 avan nou lepok par enn Herostratus ki ti met dife.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Dapre zistwar-la, so motivasion ti popilarite a ninport ki pri. Efesian, ankoler, ti anonse ki nom Herostratus ti pou zame enrezistre ankor.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Historien Grek Strabo pli tar ti not nom-la, ki kouma nou kone zordi. Temp-la ti detrui mem nwit ki Alexander le Grand ti ne.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, kouma lerwa, ti ofer pou peye pou rebatir tanp-la, me so ofer ti refize. Pli tar, apre Alexander mor, tanp-la ti rebati an 323 avan nou lepok.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Fer sir ki to lame otan relax posib pandan ki to ankor pe tap tou bann not kouma bizin - osi sey pa fer boukou mouvman extra avek to ledwa.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Alor, ou pou fatige ou mem otan ki posib. Rapel ki pa neseser touche tou bann touss avek boukou lafors pou gagn plis volim kouma lor piano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Lor lakordeon-la, pou gagn enn volim anplis, to servi bann souflet avek plis presion ouswa vites.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mistik se resers kominion avek, lidantite avek, ou konsians konsian lor enn realite iltim, enn divinite, laverite spiritiel, ou Bondie.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Krwayan la rod enn lexperyans direk, lintuisyon ouswa lintelizans dan realite divin/lezot lezot.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Bann swivan pouswiv sertin fason viv, ou bann pratik ki ena lintansion nouri sa lexperyans la.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Mistisism kapav distenge depi lezot form relizion ek kiltir parski li met lanfaz lor lexperyans direk personelenn leta konsians inik, sirtou bann ki ena enn personaz anpe, ki ena enn gran perspikasite, ki bien anvi, ouswa mem ki mem ekstatik.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhiism li enn relizion depi sou-kontinan Indien. Li finn orizine dan rezion Punjab pandan 15em syek depi enn separasyon sektaryen dan tradision Hindu
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Bann sikh konsider zot lafwa kouma enn relizion separe ar Indouism mem si zot rekonet so bann rasinn ek so bann tradision Indou.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Bann sikh apel zot krezion Gurmat, ki Punjabi pou "fason gourou". Gourou-la se enn laspe fondamantal tou bann relizyon Indien me dan Sikism li finn pran enn inportans ki form l'esansyel enn sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Sa relizion la finn fonde pandan 15em syek par Gourou Nanak (1469-1539). Ena swiv 9 lezot gourou.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Me, an Zin 1956, promes Krushchev finn teste kan bann revolt dan Pologn, kot travayer ti pe proteste kont peniri manze ek rediksion saler, ti vinn enn protestasion zeneral kont Komunism.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Mem si alafin, Krushchev ti avoy bann tank pu retabli lord, li ti les pass sertin demand ekonomik e li ti aksepte pu nom popiler Wladislawa Gomulka kuma nuvo premye minis.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Sivilizasion Indus Valley ti enn sivilizasion Lepok Bronz dan nor-wes subkontinan Indien ki ti kouver plipart Pakistan modern ek sertin zonn nor-wes Indien ek nor-es Afghanistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Sivilizasion la ti fleri dan baz Rivier Indus kot li ti gagn so nom.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Mem si ena bann professer ki spekile ki etan done ki sivilizasion ti existe osi dan basen larivier Sarasvati ki asterla finn sek, bizin apel li apropriyeman apel Sivilizasion Indus-Sarasvati, alor ki ena ki apel li Sivilizasion Harappa apre ki Harappta, premie sit la ti finn fouye dan bann lane 1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Natir militarist lempir Romenn finn ed dan devlopman dan lavansman medsin.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Lemperer Augustus ti koumans rekrit bann dokter ek in mem form premier kor medikal Romin pou servi apre bann batay.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Bann sirizien ti ena konesans lor diferan sedatif ki ti inklir morfinn depi bann extre lagrin kokliko ek scopolaminn depi lagrin erban.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Zot ti vinn konpetan dan anpitasion pou sov bann pasian depi gangn kouma bann tourniket ek bann pins arteryel pou ki disan koule.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Pandan plizier syek, lempir Romenn finn ed dan devlopman medsin ek finn form bann konnesans ki nou kone zordi.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Pureland Origami li origami avek restriksion ki zis enn pli kapav fer alafwa, pli konplex kouma pli inverse pa permet, ek tou pli ena bann lokalizasion direk.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Li ti devlope par John Smith dan bann lane 1970 pou ed bann plieer ki pena lexperyans ou bann ki ena enn tigit kapasite moter.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Zanfan devlop enn konsians lor ras ek stereotip rasyal ase zenn ek sa bann stereotip rasyal la afekte konportman.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Par exanp, bann zanfan ki identifie ar enn minorite rasyal ki steryotipe kouma pa fer bien dan lekol tend pou pa fer bien dan lekol kan zot aprann lor steryotip rasyal asosie ar zot ras.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace se trwaziem sit web ki pli popiler ki servi dan Lamerik ek li ena 54 milyon profi zordi.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Sa bann sit-la finn gagn boukou latansion, sirtou dan kad ledikasion.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Ena bann aspe pozitif lor sa bann sit web la, ki inklir, kapav mont enn paze klas fasilman, ki kapav inklir bann blog, video, foto, ek lezot karakteristik.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Sa paze la kapav gagn akse fasilman par donn zis enn adres web, seki fer li fasil pou rapel ek pou tap lor klavier ouswa pou bann ki ena difikilte dan zot kapasite moter ouswa dan zot kapasite lektir-ekrir.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Li kapav personnalis pou fer li fasil pou lir ek avek tigit ubyen boukou kouler.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: "Defisit Atansyon" se enn "sindrom nerolozik ki klasikman defini par enn triad simptom ki inklir impulsivite, distraksion, ek iperaktivite ouswa exes enerzi".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Li pa enn andikap dan aprantisaz, li enn troub aprantisaz; li "afekte 3 a 5 pourcent tou bann zanfan, kapav ziska 2 milion zanfan Amerikin".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Zanfan avek ADD ena difikilte pou konsantre lor zafer kouma travay lekol, me zot kapav konsantre lor zafer zot kontan fer kouma zwe zot zwe ouswa get zot seri prefere ouswa ekrir fraz san ponktiasion.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Sa bann zanfan la ena tandans rant dan buku problem, parski zot "angaz dan bann konportman riske, gagn lager, e defie lotorite" pu ki zot kapav stimil zot servo, parski zot servo pa kapav stimile par bann metod normal.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD afekte bann relasion avek lezot kamarad parski lezot zanfan pa konpran kouma zot azir ou ki zot fer ou kifer zot ekrir koumsa ou ki nivo maturite zot diferan.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Kouma kapasite pou gagn konesans ek pou aprann sanze, dan enn fason ki finn mansione lao, nivo de baz kot finn gagn konesans in sanze.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Lapros pou gagn linformasion ti diferan. Pa ti ena presyon dan memwar individyel mem, me kapasite pou rapel text ti vinn pliss en lobzektif.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: An esans, Renesans ti fer enn sanzman inportan dan lapros pou aprann ek difiz linformasion.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Kontrerman ar lezot primat, bann ominid nepli servi zot lame dan lokomosion ouswa avek pwa ouswa balanse atraver bann pie.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Grander ek longer lame ek lipie simpanze parey, ki reflet itilizasion lame pou sarye pwa kan zot pe marse lor zot pwin.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Lame imin li pli kourt ki lipie, avek bann falang pli drwat.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Bann lezo lame fosil de trwa milyon lane de sela montre sa sanzman dan spesializasion lame la depi lokomosion pou al manipilasion.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Ena dimounn ki panse ki gagn boukou rev ​​lisid ki finn indir artifisielman ase souvan kapav bien fatig zot.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Rezon prinsipal pou sa fenomenn-la se rezilta bann rev lisid ki agrandi longer letan ant bann leta REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Avek mwins REM par lanwit, sa leta kot ou konn somey aktyel ek ou lekor rekipere vinn ase rar pou vinn enn problem.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Sa li osi fatigan koumadir to ti pou leve sak venn-trant minit e get televizion.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Lefe-la depann lor komie fwa to servo sey reve lisid par lanwit.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Pu bann Italien, zafer pa ti al byen dan Nor Lafrik depi koumansman. Apre enn semenn Italie finn deklar lager le 10 Zin 1940, bann 11th Hussars Britanik finn pran Fort Capuzzo dan Libya.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Dan enn lasas lest de Bardia, bann Britanik finn pran General Lastucci, Chef-Inzinyer Diziem Lerwa Italien.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Le 28 Zin, Marsal Italo Balbo, Gouverner-Zeneral Libya ek aparen eritye pou Mussolini, finn mor par tir allie kan li ti pe ateri dan Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Sport modern eskrim zwe a boukou nivo, depi bann etidian ki pe aprann dan enn liniversite ziska konpetision profesionel ek Olimpik.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Sport-la prinsipalman zwe dan enn format duel, enn eskrimer ki pe duel enn lot.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Golf se enn zwe kot bann zwer servi klib pou tap boul dan trou.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Dizwit trou zwe pandan enn tour regilie, avek bann zwer ki abitie koumans lor premie trou lor parkour ek fini lor dizwitiem.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Zwer ki ena mwins frap, ou swing klib, ou seki fini terin la en premye gagne.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Zwe-la zwe lor lerb, ek lerb otour trou-la pli kourt ek apel li ver.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Kitfwa kalite tourism ki pli komen, se seki laplipar dimounn asosie ar vwayaz: Touris rekreasyon.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Se lerla ki dimounn al dan enn plas ki bien diferan ar zot lavi regilie toulezour pou relax ek amize.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Bann laplaz, bann park tem ek bann teren kanpman souvan bann landrwa pli komen ki bann touris rekreasion frekante.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Si obzektif enn vizit enn plas se pou aprann lor so listwar ek so kiltir, sa kalite touris-la apel touris kiltirel.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Bann touris kapav vizit bann diferan landrwa enn pei an partikilie ouswa zot kapav zis opte pou konsantre lor zis enn landrwa.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Bann Kolonis, kan zot ti trouv sa aktivite-la, ti finn osi demann bann ranforsman.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Bann troup ranforsi bann pozision an avan ti inklir 1er ek 3em Nouvo reziman Hanmpshire de 200 zom, anba Kolonel John Stark ek Reed (pli plitar ti vinn bann zeneral).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Bann solda Stark pran pozisyon lor longer baraz lor kote nor pozisyon kolonis.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Kan mare ba ti ouver enn trou lor larivier Mistik lor nor-es lapeninsil,zot rapidman etann baraz avek enn ti muro pier lor nor ziska fini lor bor dilo lor enn ti plaz.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley ou Stark ti met enn poto anviron 100 pie (30 met) divan baraz la ek ti komande ki personn pa tire ziska ki bann abitan la ti pas li.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Plan amerikin repoz lor lans enn atak koordine depi trwa direksion diferan.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: General John Cadwalder pou lans enn atak diversion lor kontwar britanik Bordentown, pou blok renfor.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: General James Ewing pou pran 700 solda atraver larivier Trenton Ferry, pran pon lor Assunpink Creek ek anpes ninport ki troup enemi sove.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Lafors prinsipal 2,400 zom ti pu travers larivyer 9 mil dan lenor Treton, e lerla fann an de grup, enn anba Greene ek enn anba Sulivan, pu ki li kapav lans enn latak avan lizour.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Avek sanzman depi kar a demi mil, vitess vinn mwens inportan ek endurance vinn absoliman neseser.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Natirelman, enn kourer demi mil premier klas, enn zom ki kapav bat de minit, bizin ena enn kantite vitess, me endurance bizin kiltive a tou pri.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Sertin cross country pandan liver, ansam avek travay gimnastik pou parti lao lekor, se pli bon preparasion pou sezon course.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Bann pratik nutrisyon prop tousel pa kapav zener bann performans elit, me zot kapav ena enn gran lefet lor bienet zeneral zenn atlet.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Bizin gard enn bon balans lenerzi, pratik bann labitid idratasyon efikas, ek konpran bann diferan aspe pratik suplementasion pou ed atlet amelyor zot performans ek ogmant zot lazwa dan spor.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Lekours mwatie distans enn spor ki relativman bonmarse; malerezman, ena boukou fos lide lor bann ti pies lekipman ki neseser pou partisipe.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Bann prodwi kapav aste kan neseser, me laplipar pou ena enn tipti ou okenn vre limpak lor performans.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Bann atlet kapav santi zot prefere enn prodwi mem kan li pa donn zot okenn benefis reel.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Atom kapav konsidere kouma enn parmi bann blok konstriksyon fondamantal tou matier.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Li enn entite bien konpleks ki konpoze, dapre enn model Bohr simplifye, par enn nwayo santral ki orbite par bann electron, kouma bann planet ki orbit soley - get Fig 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Nwayo konpoze par dezan parti - neutron ek proton
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Proton ena enn sarz elektrik pozitif, neutron pa ena okenn sarz, ek electron ena enn sarz elektrik negatif.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Pou Verifie viktim-la, ou bizin dabor fer enn sondaz lor sa senn-la pou ki ou kapav asire.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Ou bizin remark pozision viktim-la amezir ki ou apros li ek ninport ki pavion rouz otomatik.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Si to gagn dimal kan to esey ede, to kapav servi zis pou fer kitsoz vinn pli pir.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Letid la finn trouve ki depresion, laper ek katastrofizasion finn medie relasion ant douler ek inkapabilite dan dimoun ki soufer douler ledo.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Zis bann lefe katastrof, pa depresion ek laper ti kondisionel bann sesion PA striktire regilierman.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Dimoun ki partisip dan aktivite regilye bizin plis soutien an term konsepsion negatif lor douler pou disteng diferans ant douler kronik ek mekonfor normal fizik.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Vizion, ouswa kapasite pou trouve depann lor organ senn vizyel ouswa lizie.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Ena boukou diferan konstriksion lizie, ki ena enn konpleksite depandan lor bann kondision lorganism.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Boukou konstriksion diferan ena diferan kapasite, zot sensib a diferan longer d'ond lalimier ek zot ena diferan degre fines, zot osi bizin diferan prosesis pou fer sans depi lalimier ek diferan kantite pou fonksyone optimalman.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Enn popilasion se koleksion bann organism spesifik dan enn zonn geografik spesifik.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Kan tou bann individi dan enn popilasion zot idantik regardan enn tre fenotip partikilie ki zot koni kouma monomorfik.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Kan bann individi montre plizier varyant enn tre partikilie zot polimorfik.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Bann koloni fourmi Larme mars ek fer nik dan diferan faz osi.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Dan faz nomad, bann larme fourmi mars aswar ek arete pou kanpe pandan lazourne.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Koloni-la koumans enn faz nomad kan manze disponib finn diminie. Pandan sa faz la, koloni la fer bann nik tanporer ki sanze toulezour.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Sak sa bann dega nomad la ou bann lamars dire pandan anviron 17 zour.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Ki ete sa enn selil? Mo "selil" vinn depi latin "cella", kivedir "ti lasam", ek li ti servi premye fwa par enn mikroskopis ki ti p observ striktir enn bousson.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Selil-la se inite debaz tou bann kiksoz vivan, ek tou bann organism konpoze ar enn ou plizier selil.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Bann selil telman debaz ek kritik pou letid lavi, anfet, ki souvan apel zot "bann blok konstriksion lavi".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Sistem Nerve gard omeostaz kan li avoy bann inpilsion ner atraver lekor pou ki disan-la kontinie sirkile san deranzman.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Sa bann inpilsion ner la kapav avoye telman vit partou dan lekor ki ed gard lekor an sekirite kont ninport ki menas potansiel.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Bann tornad tap enn ti landrwa konpare ar lezot tanpet violan, me zot kapav detrir tou seki ena lor zot sime.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Bann tornad derasin pie, desir bann plans ki sorti dan bann batiman, ek zet bann loto lao dan lesiel. De poursan tanpet pli violan dir plis ki trwa er.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Sa bann tanpet mons la ena van ziska 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Bann dimounn finn fer ek servi linz pou agrandi pou milie ek milie ane.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Me, premie vre teleskop ti fer an Lerop dan dernie 16em syek.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Sa teleskop la ti servi enn kombinnasion de lenz pou fer bann obze lwin parat pli pre ek pli gran.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Lakoler ek egoism pou touzour ekziste ek li se natir koperasyon ki kan majorite profite, touzour ena plis pou gagne dan kout term kan azir kouma egois.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Esperon, la plipar dimoun pou realize ki zot meyer opsyon long term se travay ansam avek lezot.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Boukou dimounn rêve zour kan dimounn kapav vwayaz lor enn lot zetwal ek expler lezot lemond, ena dimounn ki demann zotmem ki ena deor, sertin parmi bann etranze ki kapav viv lor enn lot plant.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Me, si sa zame arive, li probabman pa pou arive pandan enn bien lonta. Bann zetwal telman dispersa ki ena trilion mil ant bann zetwal ki "voisin".
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Kitfwa enn zour, to bann gran tizanfan pou pe dibout lor enn lemond etranze ki pe demann zotmem ki zot bann ansien anset?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Bann zanimo fer depi boukou selil. Zot manz zafer ek dizer zot andan. Boukou zanimo kapav bouze.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Zis bann zanimo ki ena servo (mem si mem pa tou zanimo; dizef par exanp, pena servo.
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Bann zanimo trouve partou lor later. Zot fouy dan later, naze dan losean, ek anvole dan lesiel.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Enn selil se pli tipti inite striktirel ek fonksionel enn organism vivan (bann kitsoz) lavi.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Selil vini depi mo Latin cella ki vle dir ti lasam.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Si ou get zafer vivan anba mikroskop, ou pou trouv ki zot fer depi ti karre ouswa boul.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, enn biologist angle, trouv ti karre dan kourkan anba mikroskop.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Zot ti resanble ban lasam. Li ti premie dimoun pou obzerv selil mor.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Bann eleman ek bann konpoze kapav sorti depi enn leta ziska enn lot ek pa sanze.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Nitrozen se enn gaz ena mem propriete ki nitrozen likid. Letaz likid pli dans me bann molekil la ankor parey.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Delo enn lot lexanp. Konpoze delo konpoze ek de atom idrozin ek enn atom oksizen.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Li ena mem striktir molekiler ki li enn gaz, likid, ouswa solid.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Mem si so leta fizik kapav sanze, so leta simik res parey.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Letan li enn kitsoz ki toutotour nou, ek ki afekte tou seki nou fer, pourtan li difisil pou konpran.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Finn etidie letan par bann savan relizie, filozofik, ek siantifik pandan plizir milye lane.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Nou viv letan kouma enn seri evenman ki pase depi lavenir ziska prezan pou al dan lepase.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Letan se osi kouma nou konpar dire (longer) bann evennman.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.
